claims.label: WITNESS LOWER-BOUND FAMILY (explicit generator, 3-AP-free certificate by full pair-midpoint scan; unconditional)
claims.statement: For every k >= 1: T_k := { n in [1, 3^k - 1] : every base-3 digit of n lies in {0,1} } satisfies |T_k| = 2^k - 1, T_k is 3-AP-free, hence r_3(3^k - 1) >= 2^k - 1; consequently r_3(N) >= N^(log_3 2) * (1-o(1)) along N = 3^k - 1 (the Cantor/Behrend-free elementary floor).

witness_generator_spec.predicate: every base-3 digit of n lies in {0, 1}

claims.label: ENVELOPE UPPER BOUND (elementary block argument; finite verification envelope certified exhaustively N<=16 and by torture corpus 17<=N<=60, k=3..6)
claims.statement: For every k >= 2, every N >= 1 and every k-AP-free S subseteq [1,N]: |S| <= (k-1)*floor(N/k) + (N mod k). (Proof: the j-th block of k consecutive integers contains the d=1 k-AP, so S misses at least one element of each of the floor(N/k) full blocks; the final partial block has N mod k elements.) The comparator certification envelope is k = 3..6, N = 1..60: exhaustive at N <= 16, randomized/structured torture at 17 <= N <= 60.

claims.label: EDGE CASE (exact, brute + pair scan; under the pinned d >= 1 convention a non-trivial 2-AP is any two distinct elements)
claims.statement: r_2(1) = 1 and r_2(N) = 1 for every N >= 2.

claims.label: ELEMENTARY MONOTONICITY (unconditional; machine-checked on the certified tables)
claims.statement: r_{k+1}(N) >= r_k(N) for every k >= 2, N >= 1: the first k terms of any (k+1)-term AP form a k-term AP, so every k-AP-free set is (k+1)-AP-free. Hence on the certified tables: r_2(N) <= r_3(N) <= r_4(N) <= r_5(N) for N = 1..20.

claims.label: HONEST OPEN-SCOPE DECLARATION (binding; the #142 asymptotic formula is NOT claimed)
claims.statement: The target asymptotic formula for r_k(N) is OPEN for every k >= 3 (not even the order of magnitude is known for k = 3; the prize problem is unresolved). This solution certifies EXACTLY: the elementary envelope (Cantor lower bound family + block upper bound), the exact finite tables (r_3 for N <= 30, r_4 and r_5 for N <= 20, each with independently re-validated witnesses and cardinality-UNSAT/z3 or brute-force upper certificates), and the k = 2 edge. No asymptotic, no order-of-magnitude, no limiting-constant claim is made or certified. The true r_3(N)/N is known (Roth 1953, context baseline) to tend to 0, strictly between the certified Cantor floor N^(log_3 2 - 1) and the certified block ceiling ~ (2/3) for k = 3.
